v1.0.Description: Sed (saepe enim redeo ad Scipionem, cuius omnis sermo erat de amicitia) querebatur, quod omnibus in rebus homines diligentiores essent; capras et oves quot quisque haberet, dicere posse, amicos quot haberet, non posse dicere et in illis quidem parandis adhibere curam, in amicis eligendis neglegentis esse nec habere quasi signa quaedam et notas, quibus eos qui ad amicitias essent idonei, iudicarent. Sunt igitur firmi et stabiles et constantes eligendi; cuius generis est magna penuria. Et iudicare difficile est sane nisi expertum; experiendum autem est in ipsa amicitia. Ita praecurrit amicitia iudicium tollitque experiendi potestatem.

v1.3.2.Title: End-Of-Life
v1.3.2.Description: MySQL and MariaDB end-of-life tracker with daily refresh, EOL badges, minor-version update hints, and a dedicated card on /Home listing every monitored server with a minor version behind. Uses the slot/registry extension model to (de)register UI hooks cleanly on install/uninstall.

v1.5.0.Title: End-Of-Life
v1.5.0.Description: Adds Percona Server for MySQL + Percona XtraDB Cluster to the EOL tracker. Both catalogs mirror upstream MySQL (per Percona's stated policy) and carry their own product codes, GA dates, and support labels. Includes the v1.4.0 Fleet KPI dashboard + PDF export.

v1.6.0.Title: End-Of-Life
v1.6.0.Description: Implements #1301 quick wins: scope X/Y in header, MariaDB/MySQL official colours, X/Y centred donuts, version sprawl sorted by status with target-migration arrows + LTS badges, runway with per-bucket dates, top-servers with target/complexity/env/risk-breakdown columns, compliance gauge with target band, auto TL;DR, global legend.

v1.7.0.Title: End-Of-Life
v1.7.0.Description: Adds /Eol/byOrganization/ — per-tenant compliance comparison with sortable table (compliance pill, lifecycle mini-bar, top server-at-risk per org) and drill-down to /Eol/kpi/?org=<id>. Closes #1303.

v1.8.0.Title: End-Of-Life
v1.8.0.Description: URL-persisted env/product/status filter pills on /Eol/kpi/ (#1301), CSV export of the full top-servers list (#1301), tab-bar fleet counters per SGBD with grey-out at 0 (#1302), 'Percona Server' short label (#1305).

v1.9.0.Title: End-Of-Life
v1.9.0.Description: Adds /Eol/byEnvironment/ (compliance ranked per environment) and /Eol/matrix/ (organization × environment grid with one mini supported/warning/EOL donut per cell, deep-link to /Eol/kpi/?org=…&env=…). Closes plugin-eol#4.

v1.10.0.Title: End-Of-Life
v1.10.0.Description: Nested menu hierarchy: five active=0 child menu rows under the visible 'EOL' parent for /Eol/{kpi,byOrganization,byEnvironment,matrix,index/updates}/, so Glial resolves the page title and breadcrumb on every sub-page without polluting the visible nav.

v1.1.Description: Proinde concepta rabie saeviore, quam desperatio incendebat et fames, amplificatis viribus ardore incohibili in excidium urbium matris Seleuciae efferebantur, quam comes tuebatur Castricius tresque legiones bellicis sudoribus induratae.
